Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack, if a part is broken, gain <buf ID=1008503>[Euphoria II]</buf> after combat, up to <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

100001.name: Mobile Warfare 1
100001.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered. Unable to move before the attack, and this can be effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

100802.name: Clear Mind
100802.SpecificEffects: When attacked or retaliated against, Dodge Rate <color=#F74848>+12%</color> if no allies are within <color=#F74848>1</color> adjacent tile.

100803.name: Uppercut
100803.describe: Uses a Pile Bunker or Knuckles to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.35x</color> DMG. This attack prioritizes the Body. This skill can be executed <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

700030.name: Rush Order
700030.describe: Gains <buf ID=7100901>[Movement UP]</buf> and <buf ID=7100403>[Crit Rate UP II]</buf>, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn. Can continue action with remaining Movement.

100806.name: Shave
100806.SpecificEffects: When HP drops below <color=#F74848>50%</color> after taking damage, gain <buf ID=1008062>[Absolute Dodge]</buf> after combat. Can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time, with a trigger interval of <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

100807.name: Concentrate
100807.SpecificEffects: If unable to retaliate in combat, gain <buf ID=1008072>[Iron Will]</buf> after combat. Stacks up to <color=#F74848>5</color> times. Lasts until a critical hit is landed.

100808.name: Double Bolt
100808.describe: Uses two Melee Weapons to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.85x</color> DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times. The <color=#F74848>1st</color> attack hits the part with the highest HP. If this part is not destroyed, the <color=#F74848>2nd</color> attack will hit the same part.

100809.name: One-Inch Punch
100809.describe: Uses a Pile Bunker or Knuckles to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.6x</color> DMG.

100011.name: Mobile Warfare 2
100011.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

100021.name: Mobile Warfare 3
100021.SpecificEffects: Destroying the target can trigger <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>, allowing action with full movement distance.

100022.name: Power Innovation 2
100022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

100031.name: Alacrity 1
100031.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack with a Melee Weapon, there is a <color=#F74848>20%</color> chance to trigger <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> following the enemy's attack, dealing <color=#F74848>0.5x</color> DMG.

100033.name: Mobile Warfare 4
100033.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> or <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

100034.name: Alacrity 2
100034.SpecificEffects: Before an Active Attack, the probability of triggering <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> increases by <color=#F74848>6%</color> for each <color=#F74848>1</color> tile moved, up to <color=#F74848>30%</color>.

100035.name: Alacrity 3
100035.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.75</color>.

100036.name: Alacrity 4
100036.SpecificEffects: When triggering <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf>, prioritize hitting the part with the lowest HP.

100043.name: Power Innovation 3
100043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

100844.name: Martial 2
100844.SpecificEffects: Upon executing a perfect dodge, immediately gain <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=900050>[Euphoria]</buf>.

100845.name: Martial 3
100845.SpecificEffects: When landing a critical hit, immediately gain <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=900050>[Euphoria]</buf>.

100846.name: Martial 4
100846.SpecificEffects: Normal attacks have a chance to activate <buf ID=900010>[Gusty Strike]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>1.0x</color> DMG. For every <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=900050>[Euphoria]</buf>, the probability increases by <color=#F74848>10%</color>.
